notes.title: Oh Bugger! - Hotfix patch
notes.content: [p]Attention Pilots,[/p][p][/p][p]People from the community requested the following option so we made a quick addition to our game:[/p][list][*][p]Added settings for inverted Y and X axis on the Camera control. [/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for the feedback and we hope you have fun![/p][p][/p][p][b]Hostile Entertainment - out![/b][/p]

notes.title: Endless Mode & Fixes Now Live
notes.content:
[p]Attention Pilots,[/p][p]Over the past week, you, the Community, provided us with tons of feedback! We are very happy to see so many people play the game and enjoy it! Motivated by your kind words, we decided to make a [b]Final Patch[/b] for Oh Bugger!, containing the following:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Endless Mode[/b][/h3][p]It’s time to suit up and see how long you can survive! We’re excited to introduce [b]the ENDLESS MODE!!![/b] Explore the ship room by room, facing unending waves of aliens! How long will you last?[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Achievement Fix[/b]: Restored the “Let There Be Light!” achievement![/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio[/b]: All reported issues in the Engine room have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting[/b]: Enhanced overall lighting for better ambiance and navigation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Visibility[/b]: Improved contrast so enemies stand out more clearly[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Effects[/b]: Persistent blood splatter decals on the weapon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level Durability[/b]: Increased glass toughness in the final level - now takes more hits to shatter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial UI[/b]: Reduced popup text for quicker, smoother guidance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance & Optimisation[/b]: Optimised planetary graphics, added a navigation volume in the Engine level to improve enemy pathfinding, and applied various tweaks for smoother frame rates.[/p][/*][/list][p]Launch the game, complete the campaign and try the Endless Mode! Keep blasting those alien hordes![/p][p][b]
Hostile Entertainment - out![/b] [/p]

notes.title: The full release of Oh, Bugger! is finally here!
notes.content: [p]The full game of [b]Oh, Bugger![/b] is [b]NOW AVAILABLE[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]After launching our demo and receiving tons of feedback, we’re back with brand-new features, fixes, and expansive new playspaces![/p][p][/p][p]Dive in right away - download it here for [b]FREE[/b]:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3365900/Oh_Bugger/"][/dynamiclink]And don’t worry about download times: the entire game is just [b]1.25 GB[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Pilots, good luck! Continue your journey from the demo, finish your mission, and get paid![/p][p][/p][p]- Hostile Entertainment | Breda University of Applied Sciences[/p]

notes.title: Community Feedback: Demo Fixes Live!
notes.content: [p]Thank you to everyone who’s played our Steam Next Fest demo and shared your thoughts! As Steam Next Fest draws to a close, we’re thrilled to see how much you’ve enjoyed the demo. We’ve just shipped a hotfix today that tackles your top-requested improvements:[/p][p][/p][h3]Audio[/h3][list][*][p]The most common issue was with the game’s audio. We investigated, found the root cause, and fully resolved it.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Settings[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the screen-shake setting so it now works as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Motion blur is now disabled by default.[/p][/*][/list][h3]General Optimization[/h3][list][*][p]Improved post-processing performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced enemy performance and stability.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Character[/h3][list][*][p]We’ve changed how the mini-gun and shotgun are handled: each now uses its own button mapping.[/p][/*][*][p]The same applies to the missile ability - it also has a separate mapping.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels[/h3][list][*][p]Lighting improvements have been added for better visual guidance.[/p][/*][*][p]The engine level has been updated with a redesigned layout and new decorations.[/p][/*][/list][p]Again, thank you all for playing the demo and supporting us![/p][p]Lastly, wishlist our game to get a notification for the full release on [b]June 19[/b] - we’ve got some exciting updates incoming![/p][p]Stay up to date on all things by joining our Discord server here: [url="https://discord.gg/8BxrMdvd4p"]discord.gg/8BxrMdvd4p[/url][/p][p]Or follow us on socials: [url="https://x.com/OhBugger_Game"]X (Twitter)[/url] | [url="https://www.instagram.com/hostile.entertainment.official/"]Instagram[/url][/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update: New Features & Fixes
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to roll out a fresh update to the [b]Steam Next Fest demo[/b] of [b]Oh, Bugger![/b] - packed with new content, optimisations, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what you’ll find when you jump back into the mech:[/p][h3]Enemies[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Ranged Enemy[/b]: Face a long-range alien variant that keeps you on your toes from afar.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Behaviour Improvements[/b]: Enhanced pathing and decision-making for the Exploding and Horde enemies, making encounters more dynamic and challenging.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Optimisation[/b]: Under-the-hood tweaks reduce frame spikes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels[/h3][list][*][p][b]Objective System[/b]: Fixed various bugs and iterated on the objective system to ensure you always know where to go.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Onboarding Level[/b]: Redesigned tutorial layout and pacing to guide new pilots more intuitively through basic controls and mech mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lobby Layout[/b]: Updated architecture and sightlines in the luxury hotel lobby for smoother navigation and clearer enemy sight-lines.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Engine Layout[/b]: Reconfigured the layout to match the intended flow and heighten tension during fights.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Character:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Onboarding System[/b]: Fully implemented in-game prompts that explain core mechanics (movement, aiming, weapon switching, upgrade usage) as you progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Missile Update[/b]: Missiles now function primarily as crowd-control tools instead of one-shot kills, encouraging tactical play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Switching[/b]: Overhauled the weapon-swap logic to be more intuitive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional Upgrades[/b]: New upgrade nodes added to improve customisation options.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI & Menus[/h3][list][*][p][b]Main Menu Rework[/b]: Streamlined access to Demo, Settings, and Exit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings Menu[/b]: Brand-new in-game settings panel lets you adjust graphics and audio.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]How to Get the Update[/b][/p][p]The [b]Steam Next Fest demo[/b] will automatically download these changes the next time you launch “Oh, Bugger! Demo” - no manual steps required. [/p][p]Thank you for playing the demo and sending feedback. Strap into your mech, test out these updates, and let us know how it feels. Keep blasting those alien eggs - see you in the hotel![/p][p][/p][p]Stay up to date on all things by joining our Discord server here: [url="https://discord.gg/8BxrMdvd4p"]discord.gg/8BxrMdvd4p[/url][/p][p]Or follow us on socials: [url="https://x.com/OhBugger_Game"]X (Twitter)[/url] | [url="https://www.instagram.com/hostile.entertainment.official/"]Instagram[/url][/p]
